title: Running a pondok pesantren network
summary: Set up and run the whole MikroTik network for a 40-person pesantren: VLANs, hotspot, four APs and remote VPN access.
problem: Forty students and staff share one internet connection across several buildings, and the network needs to stay up with no dedicated IT team.
action: Configured the whole MikroTik setup myself: RB450G as the core and RB941 as secondary, four access points, VLAN segmentation, a santri hotspot, and an OpenVPN tunnel so the router can be managed remotely. Day to day I manage users, monitor traffic and handle outages.
result: A segmented, stable network that the pesantren relies on daily, which I can manage even when I am not on site.
